title: India Permits FDI in Inventory-Based E-Commerce Model Exclusively for Exports
summary: Allows 100% FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) in inventory-based e-commerce for exported domestic products via DGFT proposal.

blocks.text: 🪝 India Permits FDI in Inventory-Based E-Commerce Model Exclusively for Exports. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Allows 100% FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) in inventory-based e-commerce for exported domestic products via DGFT proposal.
Policy Relaxation: FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) restriction lifted for inventory-based e-commerce when selling domestically produced goods exclusively for export.
Marketplace vs B2C: FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) remains barred in standard domestic B2C inventory e-commerce.
FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) in export inventory model (permitted) vs domestic B2C inventory model (prohibited).
